module: Authentication workspace selection and privilege revocation

finding.scenario: Disabling cross-workspace access does not revoke the user attribute-based JWT tenant role, SwitchTenant token issuance, or remembered login/refresh workspace. With RBAC enforcement disabled, a removed ordinary member also retains access through a foreign tenant claim when X-Tenant-ID is omitted; the same explicit header correctly rejects.
finding.before: 8 permanent leaf cases fail: 3 actual Auth requests, 3 actual SwitchTenant calls, 2 login/refresh flows. .git/module-audit-20261113/auth-cross-tenant-before.log
finding.fix: Revalidate foreign tenant claims against current membership or the flag+attribute grant independently of role rollout; share that flag+attribute predicate with role resolution and token issuance. Active member roles and home/orphan compatibility are preserved.

independent_review: module_frontend_audit read this group only; no new actionable issue found, active membership and home compatibility checked.
limitations: Auth uses real Gin middleware with user validation/membership service fixtures; login/refresh/switch use real SQLite-backed user/token repositories and real issued JWT validation. No live user or server data touched.
Only listed user service methods and their callers reviewed, not the entire service package.
Full middleware suite passed before adding the separately pending logger truncation reproducer; middleware module remains partially audited.
